# =============================================================================
# browser-mcp — Environment Variables
# =============================================================================
# This file documents every environment variable the server reads. It is a
# REFERENCE, not an auto-loaded file: Node.js does not load .env files itself.
# Set these variables in your shell, in your MCP client's server registration
# (e.g. `codex mcp add --env KEY=value` / `claude mcp add -e KEY=value`), or via
# a dotenv loader if you prefer.
#
# Priority (highest wins):  tool argument -> environment variable -> default -> hard limit
# All values are read ONCE at server startup.
#
# Valid boolean forms for *-style flags: 1 / true / yes (case-insensitive).

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chromium Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Path to the Chromium binary. When empty, the server auto-detects among:
#   /usr/bin/chromium-browser, /usr/bin/chromium, /usr/bin/google-chrome,
#   /usr/bin/google-chrome-stable
# Type: absolute path | Default: (auto-detect)
CHROMIUM_PATH=

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Directory where screenshots are saved. Must be writable; paths are validated
# against traversal (screenshots can never escape this directory).
# Type: path | Default: ./screenshots | Range: any existing/creatable dir
OUTPUT_DIR=./screenshots

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Security Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allow navigation to private IP ranges (10.x, 192.168.x, 172.x, *.local,
# *.internal). Always disabled unless explicitly enabled.
# Type: boolean | Default: false
ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS=false

# RESERVED (not yet implemented): would gate a future eval-JS tool. There is
# currently NO tool that executes arbitrary JavaScript, and none is planned by
# default. Kept here so configs written against this template stay valid.
# Type: boolean | Default: false
ENABLE_EVAL_JS=false

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Timeout Configuration (milliseconds)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Default timeout for browser_navigate. Tool-level timeout_ms argument wins.
# Type: integer ms | Default: 30000 | Range: 100 - MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
NAVIGATION_TIMEOUT_MS=30000

# Default timeout for browser_click / browser_type / browser_get_text.
# Type: integer ms | Default: 10000 | Range: 100 - MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS=10000

# Hard upper bound applied to every timeout (cannot be exceeded by arguments).
# Type: integer ms | Default: 120000 | Range: >= 1000
MAX_TIMEOUT_MS=120000

# Idle time before the browser is shut down. The MCP server stays alive and
# restarts the browser on the next tool call. Set to 0 to disable idle shutdown.
# Type: integer ms | Default: 300000 (5 min) | Range: 0 (disabled) or >= 1000
IDLE_SHUTDOWN_MS=300000

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Limit Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Maximum characters returned by browser_get_text before truncation.
# Type: integer | Default: 1000000 | Range: >= 1000
MAX_TEXT_LENGTH=200000

# Maximum console messages kept in the ring buffer.
# Type: integer | Default: 500 | Range: >= 10
MAX_CONSOLE_MESSAGES=500

# Maximum lines returned by browser_get_console.
# Type: integer | Default: 500 | Range: >= 10
MAX_CONSOLE_LINES=500

# Default maximum items returned by browser_snapshot (hard cap 200).
# Type: integer | Default: 100 | Range: 1 - 200
MAX_SNAPSHOT_ITEMS=100

# Maximum screenshot area in pixels before auto-downscaling (16M = 4000x4000).
# Type: integer | Default: 16000000 | Range: >= 100000
MAX_SCREENSHOT_PIXELS=16000000

# Maximum screenshot / image payload bytes accepted in responses.
# Type: integer | Default: 10000000 | Range: >= 100000
MAX_IMAGE_BYTES=10000000

# Maximum queued state-changing operations (click/type/navigate/full-page shot).
# Type: integer | Default: 8 | Range: 1 - 64
QUEUE_LIMIT=8

# RESERVED (not yet implemented): Chromium follows HTTP redirects natively;
# this would cap redirect chains if ever needed.
# Type: integer | Default: 10
MAX_REDIRECTS=10

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Logging Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RESERVED (not yet implemented): all server logging currently goes to stderr
# with a single verbosity. This variable is accepted for future use.
# Type: error|warn|info|debug | Default: error
LOG_LEVEL=error
